trigger: A maintainer reads guardian_types.hpp:113 'The store does not write them yet'
summary: Comment says the store does not write the pair; it writes it at the event INSERT and the census upsert.

trigger: A compromised agent sends a half-set or out-of-range pair on every event
summary: One WARN per inserted event with no sampler; same posture as existing warns.

trigger: An agent decommissioned outside the cascade, or ephemeral agent ids, leave guardian_agent_order rows forever
summary: guardian_agent_order has no TTL or prune; stale ids stay counted in unordered_agents and can crowd the 50-id list (also arch-D, UP-10, SOC2 L3).

trigger: Operator reads the loose 'latest census-bearing event carried no pair' definition of unordered
summary: The unordered definition in HELP, metrics.md, rest-api.md, mcp.md, guaranteed-state.md, upgrading.md was looser than unpaired_recv_ns > COALESCE(epoch_recv_ns,0) (also arch-B, C5).

trigger: Operator reads upgrading.md 'earlier build trips it', 'start the rest' wording
summary: Deployment-contract wording near an upgrade procedure; no supported-path claim (also C7, CO-5).

trigger: Operator compares the pending-events HELP with metrics.md
summary: census_pending_events HELP omitted the per-agent step as a cause that metrics.md names.

trigger: Reader of the pair_rejected HELP believes a withheld pair leaves the census untouched
summary: 'its census is unaffected' is wrong twice: the applied unpaired verdict writes NULL/NULL to the stored pair and the order row counts it (also arch-C).

trigger: Reader of design v1.1 section 9.1 sees schema v4 only and a doubled word
summary: 9.1 DDL block lacks the v5 table; lock-order prose omits the agent row; typo.

trigger: Reader of spark-flip-gate.md sees present-tense 'the SERVER change meets' while items 1-4 are unmet
summary: Heading and two sentences claim in present tense what PR B will do.

trigger: Reader of the shared OpenAPI GuaranteedStateStatus schema expects unordered_* on the per-agent route
summary: No 'fleet route only' qualifier; epoch null-ness and non-atomic reads unstated; fragment cites #5690 twice.

trigger: Any failed agent_order_for_agent or unordered_agents read (request or sweep)
summary: Degrade-source prose stale (yuzu-alerts.yml, server.cpp HELP, metrics.md, guaranteed-state.md) and the sweep shared the request path's source guardian_rules (also C1, L1).

trigger: A database is stamped v5 and the hashed migration text is later edited
summary: The comment inside the hashed kV5Ddl text says only an earlier build can trip the extended trigger; F8 trips it from the same build (also CO-2, C7, UP-6). Must be fixed before any stamping.

trigger: unordered_agents() throws (bad_alloc) in the bare health_recompute_thread_ body
summary: std::terminate from the 15 s sweep thread; the gauge call had no try/catch (also UP-11, S2).

trigger: One (agent, rule) pair holds a large pending set so the agent row is held for the fold
summary: Waiters in the agent step hold a lease on the shared 16-connection pool for the pool lock_timeout; binding limit is the pool, not the gateway cap (also S3, UP-1, UP-2, UP-3).

trigger: Sweep tick on the revocation thread runs the full O(table) unordered_agents read with no execution bound
summary: Count-only read needed, bounded by a statement timeout (also S1, cs-2).

trigger: Every census-bearing first delivery rewrites the order row
summary: No fillfactor on guardian_agent_order defeats HOT updates.

trigger: Six statements per first delivery instead of four after the 1 s bound
summary: Two extra round trips (SET LOCAL, restore); statements could be folded with the savepoint calls via a multi-statement helper (also P8-1).

trigger: A new reject reason literal drifts from kGuardianPairRejectReasons
summary: half_set/out_of_range literals were test-pinned only.

trigger: The 2^62 bound drifts between its copies
summary: Three independent copies of the 2^62 limit (agent, pair_from_wire, census_pair); store comment calls the duplication deliberate.

trigger: A refactor swaps or drops the args at apply_wire_pair in ingest
summary: No test read the stored event/census pair back after ingesting a wire pair; swapping the arguments gave the same counters. Reporter's native band was MEDIUM (coverage gap); the derived band governs.

trigger: A savepoint control statement fails in the agent step
summary: Step-level Abandoned (single, batch, pending-write after failed step) untested.

trigger: An Ensure SQL error without a concurrent delete
summary: Only DECIDE errors and gap-hook delete races reach Failed in tests; Ensure error alone is not injected.

trigger: The future-slack disjunct of YUZU_AGENT_ORDER_FRESH_ is inverted
summary: Order-clock freshness has no boundary or future-dated test (only a 2 h age).

trigger: Shared 4-wide CI pool under I/O amplification
summary: statement_cancel section sets statement_timeout_ms=400 for every statement including setup; flake-prone.

trigger: A non-C-locale cluster
summary: Byte-order test uses ASCII ids only, so a collation mutation is caught only off a C-locale cluster.

trigger: A durable agent journal redelivers an event carrying a half-set pair
summary: pair_rejected_total and the WARN counted per delivery, not per withheld pair.

trigger: Reader assumes 'accepted' means produced a census verdict
summary: An event whose census write was refused (rule not defined) still advances the order clock.

trigger: Two same-agent deliveries received within about a millisecond; the later-received takes the row lock first
summary: currently_unordered compares two statement-start timestamps taken before the lock wait; diagnostic only in PR A, self-corrects.

trigger: A failed order step is documented as repaired by a redelivery
summary: A redelivery repairs the census row only; Repair runs no step so the order clock and counters never see the event. Reporter's native band was LOW; the derived band governs and the doc contradiction is what is fixed here.

trigger: Step failure followed by a redelivery repair; delete_agent plus Repair
summary: A paired census row can sit beside a missing or stale order row; unordered_agents undercounts; ordering:null reads as never accepted. PR B precondition: Repair must run Ensure/step or the comparator must treat a missing order row as unknown.

trigger: A savepoint control statement fails in the order step
summary: Step-level Abandoned returned an ingest error without counting census_projection_total{outcome=abandoned} as the HELP defines.

trigger: An order-table read fails while the census read works
summary: The device lens hides all guard rows with 'Guardian store degraded.' although it never renders ordering; undocumented and untested.

trigger: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, drop or rename of guardian_agent_order (manual VACUUM FULL, ALTER, TRUNCATE)
summary: A telemetry-only table hard-fails the authoritative status rollup and per-device read (503) and the lens. Owner decision 3 (2026-11-12): document and follow up; PR B decides whether to degrade ordering to unavailable.

trigger: A backward database clock step
summary: The unpaired comparison has no FUTURE_SLACK clause; a fresh unpaired event stamps below the old pair clock and reads ordered. PR B precondition.

trigger: One event with epoch or emit_seq = 2^62-1
summary: A poisoned pair pins the clock for the 1 h stale window; PR A only inflates counters; PR B must add a bound on a pair far ahead of the clock.

trigger: A held reader (pg_dump, long query_events) while the server boots against v4
summary: Migration waits for the census table under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on events within a 3 s lock_timeout; fails loudly and retries on the next boot.

trigger: An auditor reads the guaranteed_state data inventory row
summary: guardian_agent_order is listed with no retention statement and its classification (device-level agent_id, receipt-time clock readings, no user content) is not stated; D1 event-log pair columns not explicit.

trigger: A CC8.1 reviewer looks for the run ledger
summary: No governance.d fragment existed in the range; it must be committed with the work before any push.

trigger: A pilot with a cloned image sharing an agent id and epoch sees a new sticky order_uncertain flag
summary: The F8 equal-pair cause of order_uncertain was not enumerated in the flag definition, the troubleshooting list or rest-api.md.

trigger: An operator sees a non-zero unordered gauge
summary: Operator action on the gauge was thin: informational until PR B, no alert ships, 50-id cap.

trigger: An A5 ledger reader checks revisit-by dates
summary: The #2990 row has revisit-by 2026-10-31, past; this PR adds or changes no A5 entry.

trigger: A reader takes 'different agents are unaffected' as unconditional
summary: Measured on a quiet host with a pool of 8; needs the qualifier 'until the shared pool saturates'.

trigger: A step failure during pool pressure; an operator reading steps 3 and 5
summary: Runbook did not name the order step or pg_blocking_pids on guardian_agent_order as a cause of pending rows or a 503, nor warn against idle-in-transaction sessions on that table.

trigger: Ensure waits behind one holder then DECIDE behind another, or the delete-race re-run
summary: 'waits at most 1 s' is false: lock_timeout is per lock wait; a step can wait up to 4 times; the docs understate the lease hold in the paragraph that sizes the pool risk (also compliance F1, docs N1, consistency F4).

trigger: A maintainer reads the rewritten guardian_types.hpp comment
summary: The comment added to close sec-1 says nothing compares the pair; DECIDE compares in SQL (cpp-expert independently).

trigger: A dev or test database stamped v5 by an earlier build of this branch boots after the hashed text edit
summary: No sentence says an earlier-build v5 database fails the migration hash check and how to reset it.

trigger: An operator reads project-internal governance prose
summary: 'The owner accepted this trade' in operator docs and an ADR attribution with no repo-visible ruling.

trigger: Any holder of an agent's order row for 1 s or longer (another rule's fold above about 60k pending, a sync-commit stall, an idle-in-transaction session)
summary: The 1 s bound moves stranding of events stored pending (acked, reaper-exempt, never counted in the order clock) from rare to reachable; accepted pending-list class #7147; documented.

trigger: Several existing tests park a delivery behind a held lock; the margin shrank from 10 s to 1 s; shared 4-wide CI pools under sanitizers
summary: A CI leg turned red by the 1 s bound would be a policy-floor event; timing windows too narrow.

trigger: A database stamped v5 by an interim build refuses boot after the hashed text edit
summary: Hash drift refuses boot (#7158); dev and test only; no remote holds the interim tip.

trigger: The count-only sweep read exceeds its 1 s statement timeout on a very large or locked order table
summary: A timeout reads as query_error on guardian_census, indistinguishable from an outage and shared with pending_events; no last-success timestamp.

trigger: delete_agent holds the order row while locking a large pending set (1-10 s)
summary: First deliveries now strand at 1 s instead of 10 s behind a long delete_agent.

trigger: An operator reads upgrading.md step overhead
summary: 'under 1 ms' (then 'about 1 ms or less: 0.4 to 1.4 ms') contradicts RESULTS.md ON minus OFF medians; the 1.67 s point is n=2-3, not 15.

trigger: A maintainer or operator reads the step comment and the read_degrade row
summary: Dangling 'the two' referent, undefined review label 'F1', metrics.md read_degrade row implying the order read sets a statement timeout, runbook bullet naming only a lock wait as the failure cause, uncounted-case (consistency F5).

trigger: An auditor follows the SOC 2 row cross-reference and classifies epoch/emit_seq_hwm
summary: Cross-reference points at a section with no no-TTL sentence; the row omits that epoch and emit_seq_hwm are agent-asserted (range-checked only) while clocks are server time; 'stays counted' should read 'can stay counted'.

trigger: The agent step is on (the default) in the UP-1 census interleaving case
policy_floor: a FALSE-GREEN test offered as closure evidence for a blocking finding
summary: The case 'a pending event that disagrees with a verdict inserted concurrently keeps the row flagged' ran step-on: X parked in its Ensure behind W's uncommitted agent row, the second fold was never reached and the test passed with the second fold removed, so the test-coverage.md mutation-check claim was false (false-green test offered as closure evidence).

trigger: A maintainer counts the step-off v4 interleaving cases
summary: The coverage row and the comment at test_census_ordering_store.cpp:4305 say four step-off v4 interleaving cases; there are five since the UP-1 case joined them.

trigger: Default step-on run of the 40 concurrent first-delivery pairs case
summary: With the step on the two deliveries of an agent serialise on the agent row, so the case checks the serial-equivalent result end to end and never reaches the census-upsert race; its comment claimed otherwise. The assertion still holds and no mutation proof was claimed for it; the census schedules are covered by the five step-off cases.
